title: Add 'Affects task(s)' column to risks table
objective: Anchor each risk in recovery_plan_latex_contract.md to the specific canonical task IDs it threatens, so Plan-2-Tasks can populate per-task risks (Plan-2-Tasks.md:52) without inferring attribution.

plan_assets.asset_description: New risks-table header with Affects task(s) column

scope: Edit only the 'Risks and mitigations' section in dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md (currently lines 339-348)
Add the Affects task(s) column with canonical IDs
implementation_steps: Locate the existing 'Risks and mitigations' table
Append an 'Affects task(s)' column to the header
For each existing risk row, populate the new column using the attribution map from amendment 6
Use canonical IDs from P1-3's tables (e.g. P2-1, not R1.1)
If a risk has no clear attribution, mark with '—' rather than fabricating an edge
deliverables: Risks table in dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md with new Affects task(s) column
Each documented risk attributed to one or more canonical task IDs
acceptance_criteria: Each risk row has a non-empty value in the new column (— is allowed)
All listed task IDs match the regex P[1-7]-[0-9]+ and exist in P1-3's tables

cases: Risks table renders with the new column
Every attributed task ID exists in the action-item tables
No row left blank (— is acceptable)

risks: Attribution might miss a risk that materially affects a task not in the listed set — mitigated by re-reading each risk against the full task table once before commit
completion_notes: Added Affects task(s) column to Risks and mitigations table; each of 5 risks attributed to canonical Task IDs from P1-3; test_p1_6 passes 3/3.
